The '''L60 blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by [[Toydarian royal guard]]s during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was equipped with a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Scope/Legends|scope]].<ref name="TCWCE" />
